settingsIaCloudComputeDesc: Manage the isolated Google Colab CLI environment, connected accounts, and compute safety guardrails.
colabCliDesc: Kun manages the official google-colab-cli in an isolated Python virtual environment without touching system Python.
colabCliMissing: Not installed yet (provisioned automatically on first run, or prepare it now)
colabConnectionsCardDesc: Each connection uses isolated encrypted credentials and session files for concurrent multi-workspace runs.
colabSafetyCardDesc: Prevent runaway compute charges or unapproved Compute Unit (CU) spend.
colabRequireApproval: Require approval before Agent starts Colab sessions
colabRequireApprovalDesc: When enabled, colab_run shows the target account, GPU, and estimated CU cap for your approval.
colabIdleAutoStopDesc: Automatically release remote VMs after {{minutes}} minutes of post-run inactivity.
colabLowBalanceReminderDesc: Send a desktop alert when a connection drops below {{threshold}} CU (never auto-rotates accounts).
colabStopOnQuit: Stop all running Colab sessions when quitting Kun
colabStopOnQuitDesc: Automatically invoke colab stop before Kun exits so remote VMs do not keep billing.
